# ECN-2026-032 Change notice - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-HT02

Reason for change
- Routine audit of maintenance records identified that the thermocouple calibration schedule for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is out of alignment with current operational risk controls. The change standardizes the calibration interval to ensure consistent metallurgical results and to reduce scrap risk during ring heat cycles. This update aligns maintenance practice with inspection findings and corrective action recommendations.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-HT02 (Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2)
- Maintenance procedures: MM-P2-L2-HT02, MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1
- Operating procedure: SOP-P2-L2-04
- Calibration records and tags associated with thermocouples installed on EQ-P2-L2-HT02

Implementation
- The thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 40 days.
- Update MM-P2-L2-HT02 and MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 to reflect the new interval and include a checklist entry to verify calibration tag date against the interval at each preventive maintenance visit.
- Update SOP-P2-L2-04 to reference the maintenance specification for thermocouple checks and to require verification of calibration status prior to any heat treat run on EQ-P2-L2-HT02.
- Maintenance planner to schedule recurring calibration tasks in the CMMS tied to EQ-P2-L2-HT02 calibration tags and generate work orders in advance of due date.
- During the first application cycle after implementation, maintenance staff will perform a verification audit following MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 to confirm thermocouple readings are within acceptable tolerance prior to furnace use.

Approvals
- Engineering: _______________________ (print name, signature)
- Maintenance Manager: _______________________ (print name, signature)
- Operations Manager: _______________________ (print name, signature)

Related documents (for reference)
- MM-P2-L2-HT02
- MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1
- SOP-P2-L2-04
